tasks.short: Oversee construction of on-site wastewater treatment facilities.

steps.what: Read the contractor's submission for the treatment facilities.

loop.output: Submission note: item, offered product and spec clause
loop.check: Engineer checks each item against the clause
loop.stop: One pass; an item with no clause stays open
loop.why_not_simpler: Submissions are letters and sheets, not one register

steps.what: Oversee construction of the reclaimed water facilities.
Contractor reworks the treatment installation.
Judge if the wastewater treatment installation meets the spec.
Issue the site instruction for the treatment facilities.

loop.output: Site instruction naming the hold or the acceptance
loop.check: Engineer checks the instruction against the notes
loop.stop: One draft; a hold that was not inspected is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The instruction must match the site, not a generic punch list

tasks.design: The contractor's submission is lined up with the specification in {PROJECT}. The engineer still oversees construction of the reclaimed water facilities and judges the installation on site. A site instruction is sent only after that judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Submissions and site notes were separate, so each instruction was rewritten from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: A submission can be checked against clauses before the visit. The visit and the acceptance stay.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing an installation that matches the product name and still will not treat the flow.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer is on the site and will not accept a facility the inspection does not support.
tasks.altitude: Construction oversight stays the week. The engineer can withhold an instruction that was not seen on site.

reach.task: Record as-built levels and products on a small plant
reach.learn: Which as-built differences matter to treatment and which are only drafting

evidence.claim: The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Safety components in water supply are treated as high-risk under the EU AI Act.
Overseeing installation is a site judgement, not a review of the submission text.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from a contractor submission to a site instruction. Process design is out of scope.

Structured fields are item, offered product, spec clause and hold or accept. The contractor produces the submission. Fallback: the engineer types an item seen on site and marks it as an inspection finding.
Being on site is the work.
unknowns: Whether reclaimed-water quality tests are in the spec or a later permit.
research_questions: Which holds need a designer change rather than a site instruction?

incremental.description: Keep spec clauses aligned with the current facility type

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A complete submission saves the clause check. Oversight, rework judgement and the instruction stay. The low case is a site with work the submission did not describe.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop plans for water resources or efficiency programs.

steps.what: Gather water use for the efficiency programs.
Draft measures for the water resources plans.

loop.input: Use sheet and the constraint note
loop.output: Measure list with the loss it addresses and the evidence
loop.check: Engineer deletes a measure the sheet does not support
loop.stop: One draft; a measure with no loss figure is dropped
loop.why_not_simpler: Measures have to follow this system's losses, not a generic program

steps.what: Judge which plans the efficiency programs can carry.
Discuss the plans with the people who must run them.
Issue the efficiency programs plan.

loop.output: Program plan naming each kept measure and the loss it targets
loop.check: Engineer checks each target against the use sheet
loop.stop: One draft; a target not on the sheet is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The plan must match what operators agreed, not only the draft list

tasks.design: Water use is pulled into {SPREADSHEET} and a measure list is drafted only from those losses. The engineer still judges what the efficiency program can carry and discusses it with the people who run the system. The plan is issued only after the targets are checked.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans were rewritten from old programs, with losses added late.
tasks.enabler_now: A use sheet can limit which measures are drafted. Choosing the program stays.
tasks.still_hard: A measure that saves water on the sheet and cannot be operated.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer hears what operators will actually sustain.

ambition.what: Keep a measure in the plan only when the use sheet shows the loss it claims to cut.

tasks.altitude: Program discussions stay. The engineer can drop a measure that has no loss figure.

reach.task: Time the operating steps a water-saving measure would change
reach.learn: Which measures add work the saving figure ignores

evidence.claim: A solver or a price can fill a number; the engineer still judges whether the case is credible.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
An efficiency plan is not credible unless each measure points at a measured loss.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from use data to an issued program plan. Funding the measures is out of scope.
Test the {OPS_SYSTEM} export and {SPREADSHEET} before custom code.
Structured fields are period, volume, loss estimate, measure and target. Meters produce the volume. Fallback: the engineer types a period and marks it incomplete.
unknowns: Whether losses are measured or assumed.
research_questions: Which measures need a tariff or a bylaw, not only a technical plan?

already_counted.description: Judging measures the sheet cannot rank

incremental.description: Refresh loss categories when meters change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A metered system saves the use sheet and the first measure list. The judgement and the operator discussion stay. The low case is a system with no loss split.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Model water movement and the dispersion of chemical pollutants.

steps.what: Assemble inputs for the hydrological pollutant analyses.

loop.input: Boundary files and pollutant load notes
loop.output: Inputs: boundary, load, decay and release time
loop.check: Engineer checks each load against the source
loop.stop: One pass; a load without a source is blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Load notes are not the model's input table

steps.what: Build the simulation mesh for water movement.
Run dispersion cases for the chemical pollutants.
Judge whether the chemical pollutants forecast is credible.
Line the plume up with monitored supply points.
Issue the hydrological analyses and the forecast.

loop.input: Forecast judgement and the monitor comparison
loop.output: Issue note with the case, the peak and the monitor gap
loop.check: Engineer checks the peak against the result file
loop.stop: One draft; a peak not in the file is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must name the case that was run

tasks.design: Pollutant loads become model inputs, and the engineer still builds the mesh for water movement. Dispersion cases run in the model; the engineer judges whether the forecast is credible and lines it up with monitors. The issue names the case and is checked before it leaves.
tasks.previous_blocker: Loads and boundaries were retyped into the model, and a forecast was sometimes issued without a monitor check.
tasks.enabler_now: The solver can run once inputs and the mesh exist. Building the mesh and believing the plume stay.
tasks.still_hard: A plume that is numerically stable and still misses a known discharge.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which boundary the terrain does not support.

ambition.what: Refuse a pollutant forecast that fails the monitor comparison, before it is sent as an analysis.

tasks.altitude: Mesh building and forecast judgement stay. The engineer can hold an issue with a blank load or a failed comparison.

reach.task: Set a boundary from a structure that holds or releases water
reach.learn: Which structures the mesh must include as a boundary, not as open water

evidence.claim: A solver or a price can fill a number; the engineer still judges whether the case is credible.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
A prediction from past runs is not a checked dispersion result.
Making a model input executable is not the same as a correct forecast.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from loads and terrain to the issued hydrological forecast. Laboratory analysis is out of scope.
Test the model's native input tables before custom code.
Structured fields are boundary, load, decay, release time and monitor result. The monitoring record produces results. Fallback: a blank load blocks that case.
Building the mesh is not a document summary.
unknowns: Whether the model is already calibrated for this water.
Which pollutants the mesh can represent.
research_questions: Which forecasts need a new sample rather than another run?

already_counted.description: Judging plumes the monitor comparison does not settle

incremental.description: Keep decay and boundary defaults from being reused on the wrong water

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A known mesh and a complete load save the input pass and part of the run. Mesh changes, the forecast judgement and a poor monitor fit stay. The low case is an uncalibrated water.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Test pressure losses and efficiency risks on distribution networks.

steps.what: Load the water supply systems and their demands.
Test pressure losses on the distribution networks.
Identify risks and efficiency opportunities in the networks.
Record how to mitigate the pressure risks.

loop.output: Mitigation note with the node, the loss and the proposed change
loop.check: Engineer checks each loss against the result
loop.stop: One draft; a loss not in the result is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must name the case, not a generic efficiency list

tasks.design: The network case is loaded from pipe and demand fields, and pressure-loss runs stay in the model. The engineer still identifies which losses are real risks and which are efficiency opportunities. The mitigation note is filed only after each loss is checked.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each study rebuilt the network case by hand before a single pressure run.
tasks.enabler_now: Repeating a loss case is a model run once the network is loaded. Naming the risk stays.
tasks.still_hard: A low pressure that is a closed valve, a bad demand, or a pipe that should change.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows the network's operating quirks the result file does not label.

ambition.what: Run the peak pressure-loss case on every network study, not only after a complaint.

tasks.altitude: Risk identification stays. The engineer can refuse a mitigation note that is not tied to a result node.

reach.task: Confirm pipe diameter and valve state from records
reach.learn: Which records are too old to load as the network case

evidence.claim: A solver or a price can fill a number; the engineer still judges whether the case is credible.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Safety components in water supply are treated as high-risk under the EU AI Act.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from the pipe and demand records to a mitigation note. Redesign of the whole network is out of scope.
Test the model's native scenarios before custom code.
Structured fields are pipe identity, diameter, demand, case name and minimum pressure. The pipe record produces diameters. Fallback: a missing diameter is entered and that pipe is flagged.
Identifying the risk is not the model run.
unknowns: Whether valve states are in the model.
Which pressure is the duty the operator must meet.
research_questions: Which losses need a field test before a pipe is proposed for replacement?

already_counted.description: Separating real risks from model noise

incremental.description: Keep scenario names and demand patterns from drifting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A maintained network model saves the load and the loss runs. Identifying risks stays, especially where valves are unknown. The low case is a network that must be rebuilt before any run.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Site oversight of small plants stays. Program plans, pollutant forecasts and pressure studies still need the engineer, with less retyping of inputs.
reach: Civil engineering technologists on as-built records
Industrial engineers on whether an efficiency measure can be operated
skills_to_grow: Refusing a forecast that misses monitors
Running a peak pressure case before a complaint
Issuing a site instruction only for something inspected
role.ambitious_version: The engineer can stop a weak forecast or an unmeasured efficiency measure earlier, and still stands on the construction site.
